title: helm-private-values-init-hooks-encryption-tolerations-nodeselector-fix
author: Aisha Malik
description: Fix multiple issues in the private Helm chart values schema and init hook templates related to encryption, tolerations, and nodeSelector handling. Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private in air-gapped and heterogenous clusters reported failed init hooks on upgrade (panic in init job due to missing fields) and Helm validation rejecting previously accepted values when using legacy terraform-generated values. This PR stabilizes the values.schema.json to accept optional encryption keys and KMS references, makes tolerations and nodeSelector handling consistent across init hooks, and adds non-breaking fallback behavior for older value shapes. Changes are conservative and backward compatible: fields remain optional, but are validated if present; init hooks now use deterministic merge semantics so node selectors and tolerations from values do not get overwritten by defaults during upgrades. Includes upgrade/rollback notes and a migration path for clusters with custom initjobs. Checklist: 1) update values.schema.json with new union types for encryption.kmsKey/secretRef 2) update templates/init-hooks.yaml and templates/init-jobs/postgres-backup.yaml to merge tolerations and nodeSelector via Helm's default/merge pattern 3) add e2e helm test exercising pre-1.2 values shape 4) add release_notes entry and docs note in charts/private/README.md Related: ENG-1428 (private installer reliability), SUP-7731 (customer incident #2026-01-15).
commits: Normalize encryption schema and add union types for kmsKey/secretRef
Merge tolerations and nodeSelector in init hook templates
Add e2e helm test for legacy values shapes
Docs: chart README and release notes
review_comments: Priya Nair: Please add a unit test for the schema validator for the new union types. Also call out any possible breaking behaviour for clusters that relied on implicit defaults.

Aisha Malik: Added schema unit test and clarified in the PR description and README that behavior is backward compatible; defaults are only applied when fields are omitted and the merge order preserves existing user-specified values.
Evan Li: I saw a flakiness in the e2e that looks timing-related when init-jobs take >2m. Can we increase the job timeout in the test harness?
Aisha Malik: Increased timeout to 5m and added a retry on the helm upgrade step. Reran CI and tests are now green.
Marta Kovacs: Approving pending CI green. Verified chart diff locally against 1.1.3 values; init job templates no longer overwrite nodeSelector on upgrade.
release_notes: chart(private): stabilize init hook schema and merge tolerations/nodeSelector for upgrades. Fixes issues where init jobs failed on clusters with custom nodeSelectors or when encryption references were provided via secretRef. Backward compatible; no action required for most clusters. See charts/private/README.md for migration notes.
testing_notes: Unit: added schema validator tests for encryption union types. Integration: e2e helm test that performs install (1.1.3 values shape), upgrade (with new chart), and rollback verifying init jobs succeed and nodeSelector/tolerations preserved. CI: lint, chart-testing, unit-tests, helm-e2e passed after adding retry and longer job timeout. Manual: reproduced customer failure in a local minikube with tainted nodes and confirmed fix.
